facts.activity_file: responding to slope-radar and prism alarms

control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setting on EX-9101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on EX-9101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in monitoring and inspecting ground conditions, specifically responding to slope-radar and prism alarms. EX-9101 (earthmoving fleet) is in service for loading and dozing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 4 June 2006 a corrective action on EX-9101 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
